newsitem.title: USA: Boeing merger presented to Pentagon.
newsitem.headline: Boeing merger presented to Pentagon.

text.p: Executives of Boeing and McDonnell Douglas Corp. delivered their merger plan to top Defense Department officials at a courtesy meeting Monday, defense officials said.

They said Boeing President Phil Condit and McDonnell Douglas chief executive officer Harry Stonecipher delivered the plan to Deputy Defense Secretary John White and other officials at a meeting that lasted only about 15 minutes.

Though the Pentagon must decide whether to approve that specific merger, one defense official said, "In general I think people in this building believe mergers are inevitable because of budget pressures."
